blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Active speaker detection (ASD) requires reliable association between visible faces and acoustic speech, yet existing systems often degrade under challenging domains or incomplete observations. We introduce ROAM-ASD, a robust audiovisual framework that jointly models audio, full-face, and fine-grained mouth representations. A unified joint self-attention mechanism processes all input streams together with modality-agnostic query tokens, enabling direct interaction among available modality inputs. Modality dropout further improves robustness when input streams are unavailable. ROAM-ASD achieves state-of-the-art performance across five ASD benchmarks: 98.8 % 98.8\% mAP on WASD, 87.9 % 87.9\% on UniTalk, 96.5 % 96.5\% on AVA, 99.3 % 99.3\% on ASW, and 98.2 % 98.2\% on Talkies, improving over previous best systems by 5.1 5.1 , 4.7 4.7 , 0.9 0.9 , 1.0 1.0 , and 2.1 2.1 mAP points, respectively. ROAM-ASD also substantially improves zero-shot cross-dataset generalization and remains robust to missing observations.
blocks.zh: 主动扬声器检测(ASD)需要在可见的面孔和声学语音之间有可靠的关联,然而现有的系统往往在挑战性域或不完整的观测下退化. 我们引入ROAM-ASD,这是一个强大的视听框架,它共同模拟音频、全面和精细的口腔表现。 统一的联合自留机制将所有输入流与模式不可知查询符一起处理,使现有模式输入能够直接互动. 在没有输入流的情况下,放弃模式进一步提高了活力。 AM-ASD在五个ASD基准上实现了最先进的性能:WASD上为98.8%,WASD上为98.8%,UniTalk上为87.9%,AVA上为96.5%,ASW上为99.3%,Talkies上为98.2%,分别比以前最好的系统改进了5.1,4.7,4.7,0.9,1.01.0和2.1 mAP点. ROAM-ASD还大大改进了零射线跨数据集的泛化,并对缺失的观测数据保持强劲.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Active speaker detection (ASD) aims to identify, for each visible face in a scene, whether that person is producing audible speech. It is important for many downstream applications, including speaker diarization, human-robot interaction, and multimodal conversational systems. ASD models typically address this task by jointly analyzing acoustic speech activity and speech-related facial motion, making effective audiovisual fusion central to reliable detection.
blocks.zh: 主动扬声器检测(ASD)旨在为场景中的每个可见面孔识别此人是否正在产生可听的语音. 这对许多下游应用都很重要,包括扬声器的对角化、人与机器人的相互作用以及多式联运的对话系统。 ASD模型一般通过联合分析声学语音活动和与语音相关的面部运动来解决这项任务,使有效的视听聚变成为可靠的检测中心.

blocks.en: Recent years have seen substantial progress in audiovisual modeling for ASD. ASC [ 1 ] organizes audiovisual observations from multiple visible speakers over time and learns pairwise and temporal relations to capture long-range multi-speaker dependencies. MAAS [ 2 ] represents speech events and candidate speakers in a graph, using graph reasoning to associate detected speech with the corresponding visible speaker. TalkNet [ 19 ] performs bidirectional cross-attention between audio and visual representations, followed by self-attention to capture longer-term dependencies. ASDNet [ 8 ] combines audiovisual features with inter-speaker relation modeling and temporal context, while Light-ASD [ 9 ] adopts a lightweight fusion architecture with recurrent modeling for efficient detection. LoCoNet [ 21 ] captures long-range dependencies within each speaker track together with short-term interactions among different speakers. Beyond architectural fusion, TalkNCE [ 6 ] strengthens audio-visual correspondence through talk-aware contrastive learning. TS-Talk [ 5 ] introduces target-speaker information into the fusion process to condition detection on a specific speaker, while LASER [ 12 ] incorporates lip-landmark guidance during training to emphasize localized speech-related facial motion.
blocks.zh: 近年来,在为ASD制作视听模型方面取得了重大进展。 ASC [1] 随着时间的推移,组织多种可见的扬声器的视听观测,并学习对称和时间关系,以捕捉远程多语种依赖. MAAS[2]在图表中代表演讲事件和候选演讲者,使用图表推理将检测到的演讲与相应的可见演讲者联系起来. TalkNet [19] 进行音频和视觉表达的双向交叉关注,然后自我关注以捕捉较长期的依赖性. ASDNet [8] 将视听特征与语音间关系建模和时间上下文相结合,而光-ASD [9] 采用了轻量级聚变结构,并经常进行建模以高效检测. LoCoNet[21]抓住了每个发言者轨道中的长期依赖性,以及不同发言者之间的短期互动。 除了建筑聚变之外,TalkNCE [6]通过讲解意识的对比性学习加强视听通信. TS-Talk [5]在聚变过程中引入了目标语言信息,以限定特定扬声器的检测,而LASER [12]在训练中加入了唇形地标指导,以强调本地化的语音相关面部运动.

blocks.en:
However, most existing ASD methods are developed and evaluated primarily on AVA-ActiveSpeaker [ 15 ] , the most widely used benchmark in the field. AVA is constructed from movie content and typically contains relatively clear, close-up face observations, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a). Real-world recordings can be substantially more challenging, involving multiple nearby speakers, interfering voices and environmental noise, and facial occlusion.
Representative examples are shown in Fig. 1 (b)-(c), drawn from the recent in-the-wild benchmarks WASD [ 16 ] and UniTalk [ 11 ] . Therefore, although recent methods have nearly saturated AVA, with several achieving over 95% mean average precision (mAP), their performance drops substantially on these more challenging datasets, as shown in Fig. 2 , where we summarize previously reported results across AVA, WASD, and UniTalk. For example, the strongest baseline reported on UniTalk achieves only 83.2% mAP [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,大多数现有的ASD方法主要是在AVA-AactiveSpeaker [15]上开发和评价的,这是该领域最广泛使用的基准. 如图1(a)所示,AVA是根据电影内容构建的,通常包含相对清晰的特写面部观察。 真实世界的录音可能更具挑战性,涉及附近多个发言者,干扰声音和环境噪音,以及面部闭塞。
图1(b)-(c)列出了代表性的例子,这些例子取自最近的WASD[16]和UniTalk[11]。 因此,尽管最近的方法几乎已经饱和了AVA,有几种方法实现了95%以上的平均精度(mAP),但它们的性能在这些更具挑战性的数据集上大幅下降,如图2所示,我们在图2中总结了先前在AVA、WASD和UniTalk上报告的结果。 例如,UniTalk上报告的最强基线只达到83.2%的mAP[11].

blocks.en: One potential reason for this performance gap under in-the-wild conditions lies in how visual speech information is represented. Most existing ASD systems represent visual evidence primarily through full-face features, which can be distracted by non-speech facial activity. For example, in Fig. 1 (b), a non-speaking person has an open mouth in a crowded and noisy scene, which may provide misleading visual evidence. Roxo et al. [ 16 ] further show that state-of-the-art (SOTA) ASD models fail when a visible person exhibits slight lip motion or expressive mouth movements while another, off-screen person is speaking, as well as under facial occlusion and interfering background voices. In contrast, speech production is most directly reflected in localized mouth and lip motion. Fine-grained mouth representations can therefore provide complementary evidence for distinguishing true articulation from unrelated facial movements. The effectiveness of lip-landmark guidance in LASER [ 12 ] further supports the value of such localized cues. However, fine-grained mouth information has rarely been explicitly modeled in existing ASD systems.
blocks.zh: 造成这种无所不在条件下的性能差距的一个潜在原因是视觉语音信息是如何表现的. 大多数现有的ASD系统主要通过全面特征代表视觉证据,这些特征可以被非语音面部活动所分心. 例如,在图1(b)中,一个不讲语言的人在拥挤和吵闹的场景中张开嘴,这可能会提供误导性的视觉证据. 罗曹等. [16]进一步显示,当一个醒目的人物在另一个非屏幕人物说话时表现出轻微的唇动或表达性嘴动,以及在面部隔离和干扰背景声音下,最先进的(SOTA)ASD模型失败. 相比之下,语音制作最直接体现在局部的口腔和唇动中. 因此,精细的口腔表情可以提供补充证据,用以区分真实的表情和无关的面部动作. LASER [12] 的唇形标记指导的有效性进一步支持了这种局部提示的价值. 然而,细纹口信息很少在现有的ASD系统中被明确模拟.

blocks.en:
A second concern is how multimodal information is fused. Cross-attention is widely used in ASD models, such as TalkNet and TS-Talk, to exchange information between audio and visual representations. However, these interactions are typically defined between specific pairs of streams, with one providing the queries and another the keys and values.
Extending such a design to additional inputs requires specifying additional fusion paths, tying the architecture to a predefined set of streams. This can become restrictive in real-world recordings, where some inputs may be unavailable or unreliable due to facial occlusion, poor visual resolution, or corrupted audio. In such cases, a fusion mechanism that can directly operate on the available inputs, without requiring predefined pairwise interactions, would be more robust to incomplete observations.
blocks.zh:
第二个关切问题是多式联运信息如何结合。 交叉意向在ASD模型中被广泛使用,如TalkNet和TS-Talk,用于音频和视觉表达之间的信息交流. 然而,这些相互作用通常是在特定的对流之间定义的,其中一种提供查询,另一种提供密钥和值.
将这种设计扩展到额外的输入需要指定额外的聚变路径,将架构与预定义的一组流连接起来. 这在现实世界的录音中可能变得有限制性,因为一些输入可能因为面部闭塞,视觉分辨率差,或音频腐败而无法提供或不可靠. 在这种情况下,一个聚变机制可以直接在可获得的投入上运行,而不需要预先定义的对偶相互作用,这种机制将比不完全的观测更有力。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we introduce ROAM-ASD, a robust active speaker detection framework designed for in-the-wild conditions. Rather than relying solely on a global face representation, ROAM-ASD jointly models audio, full-face, and fine-grained mouth streams as complementary inputs. The mouth-region representations are cropped directly from the detected face and therefore require no additional input source or annotation.
We further introduce a unified joint self-attention fusion mechanism in which audio, face, and mouth tokens are processed together in a single sequence. Self-attention allows each token to directly interact with all available tokens, eliminating the need to define separate pairwise fusion paths between specific input streams. During training, we apply modality dropout to randomly remove individual input streams, exposing the model to different combinations of available inputs and improving robustness to missing observations at inference time.
We conduct extensive experiments across five ASD benchmarks, covering in-domain evaluation, zero-shot cross-domain transfer, and incomplete-modality conditions. ROAM-ASD achieves consistent improvements across these settings, with particularly large gains on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks.
The main contributions are: • We introduce ROAM-ASD, which incorporates fine-grained mouth representations alongside audio and face features and uses unified joint self-attention with modality-agnostic query tokens to fuse available inputs without predefined pairwise fusion paths. • ROAM-ASD achieves SOTA performance across five ASD benchmarks: 98.8% mAP on WASD, 87.9% on UniTalk, 96.5% on AVA, 99.3% on ASW, and 98.2% on Talkies, improving over previous best systems by + 5.1 \mathbf{+5.1} , + 4.7 \mathbf{+4.7} , + 0.9 \mathbf{+0.9} , + 1.0 \mathbf{+1.0} , and + 2.1 \mathbf{+2.1} mAP points, respectively. It also demonstrates substantially stronger zero-shot cross-dataset generalization. ASD examples are available at https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD/ . • ROAM-ASD is highly robust to scattered missing observations and maintains useful performance under extended loss of individual input streams. Examples of missing-input conditions are available at https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD-modality/ .
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了ROAM-ASD,这是一个为零星条件设计的强有力的主动扬声器检测框架。 ROAM-ASD不是仅仅依靠全球面孔代表,而是联合将音频、全面和精细的口流作为补充投入。 口-区表示直接从检测到的面部裁剪,因此不需要额外的输入源或注释.
我们进一步实行统一的联合自觉聚变机制,声音,面孔,口形符号按单一顺序一起处理. 自意使每个令牌能够直接与所有可用的令牌相互作用,从而不需要在特定输入流之间定义单独的对映融合路径. 在培训期间,我们采用模式退出来随机删除单个输入流,使该模式暴露在可用输入的不同组合中,并在推断时提高缺失观测的强度。
我们通过五个ASD基准进行广泛的试验,包括域内评价、零射跨域转让和不完全模式条件。 AM-ASD在所有这些环境中都取得了一致的改进,在具有挑战性的内部基准方面取得了特别大的进展。
主要贡献是: 我们采用ROAM-ASD,它结合音频和面部特征,结合精细的口腔表现,并使用统一的联合自觉,使用模式不可知的查询符,将可用的输入引信,而无需预先定义的双向聚变路径。 • ROAM-ASD在五个ASD基准上实现了SOTA性能:WASD上为98.8%mAP,UniTalk上为87.9%,AVA上为96.5%,ASW上为99.3%,Talkies上为98.2%,比以往最好的系统分别改进了+5.1\mathbf+5.1},+4.7\mathbf+4.7},+0.9\mathbf+0.9},+1.0\mathbf+1.0}和+2.1\mathbf+2.1}mAP点. 它还表明,零射交叉数据集的通用性大大加强。 在https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD/网址上可查到ASD实例。 ROAM-ASD非常强大,能够分散缺失的观测结果,并在单个输入流的扩展损失下保持有用的性能。 缺少输入条件的例子见https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD-modelity/。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 ROAM-ASD Model
blocks.zh: 2个ROAM-ASD模型

blocks.en: Following the standard track-based ASD formulation [ 19 , 21 , 20 ] , we process one face track at a time. Each track consists of the scene audio and a sequence of face crops corresponding to the same person, sampled at the video’s native frame rate. For each video frame t t , the model predicts a speaking probability p t p_{t} , with the label y t ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{t}\in\{0,1\} indicating whether the tracked person is audibly speaking.
blocks.zh: 按照基于标准轨迹的ASD配方[19,21,20],我们一次处理一个面轨. 每个音轨由场景音频和与同一人对应的相貌作物序列组成,以视频的原生帧速率取样. 对于每个视频帧 t t, 模型预测一个说话概率 p t p_{t}, 标签 y t { { 0, 1} y_{t}\in {0, 1}} 表示被跟踪者是否在说话 。

blocks.en: ROAM-ASD augments this conventional audio-face input with a fine-grained mouth stream cropped directly from each tracked face. The resulting three input streams are denoted by c ∈ { a , f , m } c\in\{a,f,m\} for audio, face, and mouth, respectively. Fig. 3 illustrates the overall architecture. Each stream is processed by a modality-specific encoder and projected to a common feature space (dimension d = 256 d=256 here), producing audio, face, and mouth representations 𝐱 a ∈ ℝ L × d \mathbf{x}^{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times d} , 𝐱 f ∈ ℝ T v × d \mathbf{x}^{f}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{v}\times d} , and 𝐱 m ∈ ℝ T v × d \mathbf{x}^{m}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{v}\times d} , respectively. These representations are jointly processed with query tokens through self-attention. The resulting fused query representations 𝐅 q ∈ ℝ T v × d \mathbf{F}^{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{v}\times d} are combined with skip features from the individual streams and passed to a temporal prediction head to produce frame-level speaking probabilities.
blocks.zh: ROAM-ASD通过直接从每张履带面上划出的细纹口流来增强这种传统的音频面输入. 由此产生的三个输入流分别由c { { a, f, m } c\in\{a, f, m\} 表示,用于音频,面部和口部. 图3说明了总体结构。 每个流由特定模式的编码器处理,并投射到一个共同的特征空间(dimension d = 256 d = 256 here),产生音频,面部和口部表达 x a → R L → d → mathb{ → mathb{ → { → mathb{ → x f → t\ → mathb{ → x mathb}, 和 x m → R → mathb{ → t_{v}\ t}\ times d} 分别是 。 这些表述通过自觉与查询符共同处理. 由此产生的F q Q Q R T v × d mathbf{F QQQQin\ mathbb{R}^{T_{v}\times d}与单个流的跳过特性结合,并传递到时间预测头,以产生帧级说话概率.

blocks.en: Audio encoder. We use the frozen encoder of Whisper-large-v3 [ 14 ] to extract audio representations from the input waveform. A trainable linear projection maps them to audio features 𝐱 j a ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{x}^{a}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , where j j indexes the audio tokens.
blocks.zh: 音频编码器。 我们使用Whisper-large-v3[14]的冷冻编码器从输入波形中提取音频表达. 一个可训练的线性投影图将它们映射到音频特性 x j a \ \ mathbf{ x\ \ \ \ \\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 上, 其中 j 表示音频符号 。

blocks.en: Face encoder. Following [ 20 ] , we use a compact face encoder consisting of a 3D convolutional stem, a per-frame ResNet-18 backbone, a V-TCN block, and a linear projection. Each tracked face crop is resized to 122 × 122 122\times 122 and passed through the encoder to produce face features 𝐱 t f ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{x}^{f}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} . The face encoder is trained from scratch jointly with the downstream ASD model.
blocks.zh: 面部编码器. 继[20]之后,我们使用一个紧凑的面部编码器,由3D的演化干,每帧的ResNet-18主干,V-TCN块和线性投影组成. 每个履带面料作物的尺寸被调整为122×122122\时,经过编码器生成面料特征 x t f → R d\ mathbf{x}^{f}_{t}\in\ mathbb{R}^{d}. 面部编码器从零开始与下游的ASD模型联合训练.

blocks.en: Mouth encoder. We adopt the pretrained visual speech recognition encoder from Auto-AVSR [ 10 ] , consisting of a 3D convolutional frontend, a ResNet-18 backbone, and a Conformer encoder pretrained for lipreading on 3291 hours of visual speech data. Since the pretrained model is not optimized for ASD, we adapt it using rank-8 LoRA [ 4 ] on the attention projections while keeping the original encoder parameters frozen. A trainable linear projection maps the adapted features to mouth representations 𝐱 t m ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{x}^{m}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} .
blocks.zh: 口编码器. 我们采用了Auto-AVSR[10]的预训视觉语音识别编码器,包括一个3D演化前端,一个ResNet-18骨干,以及一个Conformer编码器,在3291小时的视觉语音数据上进行唇读预训. 由于预先训练过的模型没有为ASD进行优化,所以在注意度预测上我们使用级-8 LoRA [4] 进行调整,同时保持原编码器参数的冻结. 一条可训练的线性投影图 : 口腔表达式的调整功能 x t \ m \ mathbf{ x\ m\\ t\\ n\ mathbb{ R\ d} 。 。 。

To obtain the mouth input, we apply MediaPipe FaceMesh within each
tracked face to localize the mouth region, which is aligned and resized
to 88 × 88 88\times 88 grayscale. Short landmark-detection failures ( < 1 <1 s) are handled by interpolating crop coordinates between neighboring valid detections, while longer failures are treated as missing observations.

blocks.en:
Joint self-attention modality fusion. Given the encoded modality representations, we concatenate them into a joint sequence for fusion. For a track containing T v T_{v} video frames, we introduce one query token for each frame, resulting in T v T_{v} query tokens. All query tokens are copies of a single learned vector 𝐪 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , broadcast along the time axis. Unlike 𝐱 a \mathbf{x}^{a} , 𝐱 f \mathbf{x}^{f} , or 𝐱 m \mathbf{x}^{m} , the query tokens contain no modality-specific information and serve as modality-agnostic representations for accumulating fused information from the available input streams.
The resulting sequence contains 3 ​ T v + L 3T_{v}+L tokens and is initialized as 𝐮 i ( 0 ) = 𝐳 i + 𝐞 type ⁡ ( i ) \mathbf{u}_{i}^{(0)}=\mathbf{z}_{i}+\mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{type}(i)} , where 𝐳 i ∈ { 𝐪 , 𝐱 j a , 𝐱 t f , 𝐱 t m } \mathbf{z}_{i}\in\{\mathbf{q},\,\mathbf{x}_{j}^{a},\,\mathbf{x}_{t}^{f},\,\mathbf{x}_{t}^{m}\} and 𝐞 type ⁡ ( i ) ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{type}(i)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} is the corresponding type embedding for audio, face, and mouth tokens, and zero for query tokens. Each token is associated with its own physical timestamp, which is incorporated into self-attention later using RoPE [ 18 ] together with an ALiBi-style attention bias [ 13 ] . This makes the initially identical query tokens frame-specific. When an input stream is unavailable, its tokens are masked out during self-attention fusion, while the query tokens and tokens from the remaining streams remain available.
The joint sequence is processed by 4 pre-norm Transformer layers with 256-dimensional, 4-head self-attention and a 1024-dimensional feed-forward network with GELU activation. Self-attention is performed jointly over the entire sequence, allowing query, audio, face, and mouth tokens to interact directly within every layer. After the final layer, the query-token outputs are layer-normalized and retained as the fused representations 𝐅 q ∈ ℝ T v × d \mathbf{F}^{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{v}\times d} . Since these query tokens are modality-agnostic and never masked, the fusion does not depend on any particular input stream being present and can therefore operate when one or more streams are missing.

联合序列由4个预规范变压器层进行处理,具有256维,4头自留心,以及带有GELU激活的1024维进气网络. 自觉是在整个序列上联合进行的,允许查询,音频,面部,和口信符在每个层内直接交互. 在最后一层之后,查询到的输出是层态化的,并作为F q QQ R T v × mathbf{F}^{q}\in\mathb{R}^{T_{v}\times d}的熔化表示保留. 由于这些查询符是模式不可知的,从不蒙面,所以聚变并不取决于是否存在任何特定的输入流,因此可以在缺少一个或多个流时运行.

blocks.en: Skip connections and prediction head. The fused query representations 𝐅 q \mathbf{F}^{q} are combined with skip features from the individual input streams before frame-level prediction. These skip connections provide the prediction head with direct access to the original encoder representations, reducing the risk that useful frame-level cues are overly smoothed or specialized by the fusion module. Since the audio representations are produced at a different temporal rate from the video, they are linearly interpolated to the video frame positions, yielding 𝐱 ~ t a \tilde{\mathbf{x}}^{a}_{t} . The face and mouth representations, 𝐱 t f \mathbf{x}^{f}_{t} and 𝐱 t m \mathbf{x}^{m}_{t} , are already frame-aligned. For each video frame t t , we concatenate the fused query representation with the three stream-specific features, [ 𝐱 ~ t a ; 𝐱 t f ; 𝐱 t m ; 𝐅 t q ] ∈ ℝ 4 ​ d [\tilde{\mathbf{x}}^{a}_{t};\mathbf{x}^{f}_{t};\mathbf{x}^{m}_{t};\mathbf{F}^{q}_{t}]\in\mathbb{R}^{4d} . The concatenated features are first projected to 128 dimensions using a 1D convolution, followed by an 8-head, 128-dimensional Transformer encoder layer with a 512-dimensional feed-forward network for temporal modeling, and a 1D convolution with kernel size 3. A final linear layer maps the resulting features to two output logits, followed by a softmax to obtain the frame-level speaking probability.
blocks.zh: 跳过连接和预测头。 引信查询表示式F q \ mathbf{F}^{q}与单个输入流的跳过特性结合,然后进行帧级预测. 这些跳过连接为预测头提供了直接访问原始编码器的表示,降低了有用的帧级提示被聚变模块过度平滑或专门化的风险. 由于音频表达方式与视频的时速不同,它们被线性插到视频帧位置,产生x~t a\tilde\mathbf{x}}^{a}_{t}. 面部和口部的表示式, x t f\ mathbf{ x}^{f}_{t} 和 x t m\ mathbf{ x}^{m}_{t} 已经是帧对齐的 。 对于每个视频帧 t t , 我们用三个流特定功能将已连接的查询表达式组合在一起, [x ~ t a; x t f; x t q]; f t q] → R 4 d [\tilde\ mathbf{ x}}^{a}_{t}t}];\ mathb{ x}^{f}_{t}t}];\mathb{ f}^{q}_{t}]\in\ mathbbb {R}^{4d} 。 调制的特征首先采用1D的演化法投射到128维,然后是8头128维变形器编码器层,并配有512维的供时建模的进取网,以及1D的演化,内核大小3. 最终的线性图层将由此产生的特征映射到两个输出日志,然后是软马克斯,以获得帧级的演讲概率.

blocks.en: Modality dropout training. Although joint self-attention can operate with missing inputs, training only on complete observations may cause the model to rely heavily on all three streams. We therefore apply modality dropout during training. For each clip, the face and mouth streams are independently dropped with probability 0.15. For audio, we distinguish between missing input and observed silence: the audio stream is removed with probability 0.15, while with probability 0.10 the waveform is set to zero but the stream is retained. Dropout decisions are independent across streams, exposing the model to different combinations of available inputs.
blocks.zh: 模式性辍学培训。 虽然联合自留可以使用缺失的投入进行操作,但只进行完整的观测培训可能导致模型严重依赖所有三个流. 因此,在培训期间,我们采用退出模式。 对于每个片段,面部和口腔溪流都以0.15的概率独立下降. 对于音频,我们区分缺失输入和观察到的沉默:音频流以概率0.15去除,而概率0.10的波形设定为0,但保留流. 辍学决定在各流之间是独立的,使模型暴露在可用投入的不同组合中.

blocks.en: All models follow the same training recipe. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , with 500 iterations of linear warm-up followed by cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Training uses mixed precision and gradient clipping at 5.0. For data augmentation, we add MUSAN noise [ 17 ] at an SNR uniformly sampled from 5 to 20 dB.

blocks.en:
We conduct two sets of experiments. First, we evaluate ASD performance under complete audiovisual observations using both in-domain and zero-shot cross-domain evaluation. For in-domain evaluation, models are trained and evaluated on the corresponding dataset, whereas zero-shot evaluation directly evaluates a model trained on one dataset on another without adaptation.
Second, we evaluate robustness to missing inputs by removing audio, face, mouth, or both visual streams. We consider both continuous and scattered missing observations. For continuous missing segments, we use holes spanning 5 % 5\% , 15 % 15\% , or 30 % 30\% of each track, repeated to reach 30 % 30\% total coverage, as well as single holes spanning 50 % 50\% or 75 % 75\% of the track and complete ( 100 % 100\% ) stream removal.
We report mAP over the labeled frames within the missing regions and measure degradation relative to the same model evaluated on the corresponding frames without missing inputs. We compare models trained with and without modality dropout.
blocks.zh:
我们进行两组实验。 第一,我们利用域内和零镜头跨域评价,在完整的视听观察下评价ASD性能。 就域内评价而言,模型在相应的数据集上接受培训和评价,而零镜头评价则直接评价在另一套数据集上培训的模型,而不进行调整。
第二,我们通过删除音频、面部、口腔或两条视觉流来评估缺失输入的强度。 我们认为不断和分散的缺失观察。 对于连续缺失的片段,我们使用横跨5% 5 +%,15% 15 +%,或30% 30 +%的洞,重复到达到30% 30 +%的总覆盖度,以及横跨50% 50 +%或75% 75 +%的单孔,完成(100% 100 +%)的溪流清除。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate in-domain ASD performance on UniTalk (Table 1 ), WASD (Table 3 ), and AVA, Talkies, and ASW (Table 4 ). The best result in each setting is shown in bold . ROAM-ASD consistently outperforms previous methods across all five benchmarks, achieving 87.9 % 87.9\% , 98.8 % 98.8\% , 96.5 % 96.5\% , 98.2 % 98.2\% , and 99.3 % 99.3\% mAP on UniTalk, WASD, AVA, Talkies, and ASW, respectively. Compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, this corresponds to absolute improvements of 4.7 \mathbf{4.7} , 5.1 \mathbf{5.1} , 0.9 \mathbf{0.9} , 2.1 \mathbf{2.1} , and 1.0 \mathbf{1.0} mAP points, respectively. The gains are particularly pronounced on the more challenging UniTalk and WASD benchmarks, as shown in Fig. 2 . Representative detection examples from all five benchmarks are available at https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD/ .

blocks.en: We further evaluate zero-shot cross-dataset generalization, where a model trained on one dataset is directly evaluated on another without adaptation. In the UniTalk study [ 11 ] , TalkNCE shows the strongest cross-dataset performance among the evaluated baselines, and we therefore use it as the reference baseline in Table 2 . ROAM-ASD outperforms TalkNCE in all 12 12 cross-dataset settings. The gains are particularly pronounced when training on ASW, with improvements of 59.3 59.3 , 28.9 28.9 , and 41.0 41.0 mAP points on AVA, Talkies, and UniTalk, respectively. When trained on UniTalk, ROAM-ASD also improves over TalkNCE by 5.2 5.2 , 2.9 2.9 , and 8.7 8.7 points on AVA, Talkies, and ASW, respectively. These results demonstrate substantially stronger cross-dataset generalization across different domains.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价零镜头跨数据集的泛化,即在一个数据集上培训的模型在另一个数据集上直接评价而不进行调整. 在UniTalk研究[11]中,TalkNCE在评估的基线中显示了最强的跨数据集性能,因此我们用它作为表2中的参考基线. ROAM-ASD在所有12个跨数据集设置中都超过了TalkNCE. 在 " ASW " 培训方面,成绩尤其显著,AVA、Talkies和UniTalk分别改进了59.3 59.3、28.9 28.9和41.0 41.0 mAP点。 在接受UniTalk培训时,ROAM-ASD还比TalkNCE在AVA,Talkies和ASW上分别提高了5.2分,2.9分,8.7分. 这些结果表明,不同领域的跨数据集通用性大大加强。

blocks.en: We next evaluate the robustness of ROAM-ASD to incomplete input streams at inference time. We consider two temporal patterns of missing observations: scattered missing observations, where missing portions are distributed throughout the sequence, and continuous missing segments, where observations are unavailable for a contiguous portion of the sequence. Fig. 4 shows the results under scattered missing observations. ROAM-ASD is highly robust to this type of input loss. Across all four datasets and missing-stream configurations, removing up to 15 % 15\% of the observations causes at most approximately 1.5 1.5 mAP points of degradation. This indicates that scattered short-term missing observations have little impact on ROAM-ASD. We next consider the more challenging case of continuous missing segments in Fig. 5 . Since missing the face stream alone results in little performance degradation, we omit this condition. ROAM-ASD remains relatively robust to continuous mouth loss on WASD, AVA, and ASW, with only 0.9 0.9 , 3.1 3.1 , and 3.1 3.1 mAP points of degradation, respectively, even when the mouth stream is unavailable for the entire sequence. UniTalk is more sensitive, with a degradation of 9.8 9.8 points. In contrast, the degradation increases substantially as both face and mouth observations become unavailable for longer periods. Under complete removal of both visual streams, this behavior follows from the nature of the ASD task itself: ASD determines whether a particular visible face is producing the observed speech. Without any visual information about the target face, audio alone can indicate the presence of speech but cannot associate that speech with the target person. Consequently, different face tracks sharing the same audio become indistinguishable to the model.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价ROAM-ASD在推论时对输入流不全的强度. 我们考虑了缺失观测的两种时间模式:分散的缺失观测,即缺失部分在整个序列中分布;连续的缺失部分,即无法对序列中某一毗连部分进行观测。 费格。 4在分散的缺失观测下显示结果. ROAM-ASD对于这种输入损失非常强大. 在所有四个数据集和缺失流配置中,消除了高达15%的15%的观测结果,最多约1.5 mAP降解点。 这表明分散的短期缺失观测对ROAM-ASD影响不大. 我们接下来审议图5中持续缺失部分的更具挑战性的案例。 由于光是缺少面部光流就导致很少性能退化,我们省略了这一状况. ROAM-ASD在WASD,AVA,和ASW上仍然相对坚固,持续出现口损,分别只有0.9 0.9,3.1 3.1和3.1 mAP的降解点,即使整个序列没有口流. UniTalk更敏感,降解度为9.89.8分. 与此相反,随着脸部和口部的观测在较长的时间内变得无法进行,退化程度大大增加。 在两个视觉流的完全去除下,这一行为源于ASD任务本身的性质: ASD确定某个特定的可见面是否正在产生被观察到的语音. 没有关于目标面的视觉信息,仅音频就可以表示存在言论,但不能将该言论与目标人联系起来. 因此,分享相同音频的不同面音轨对模型变得不可区分.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 examines the contribution of modality-dropout training under continuous missing segments. Positive values indicate reduced degradation compared with training without modality dropout. The benefit generally becomes larger as the missing ratio increases, particularly for mouth removal. When the mouth stream is completely unavailable, modality dropout reduces the degradation by 23.6 23.6 , 51.8 51.8 , 40.3 40.3 , and 39.3 39.3 mAP points on WASD, AVA, UniTalk, and ASW, respectively. These results show that modality dropout is particularly important when an input stream is unavailable for an extended period. Representative detection examples under missing-input conditions are available at https://wangpuup.github.io/ROAM-ASD-modality/ .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented ROAM-ASD, a robust ASD framework that jointly models audio, full-face, and fine-grained mouth information. ROAM-ASD uses unified joint self-attention with modality-agnostic query tokens to fuse all available inputs without predefined pairwise fusion paths, while modality dropout exposes the model to incomplete inputs during training. Experiments across five ASD benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over previous methods in both in-domain and zero-shot cross-dataset evaluation, with particularly strong gains on the challenging WASD and UniTalk benchmarks. ROAM-ASD is also highly robust to scattered missing observations and maintains useful performance under extended loss of individual input streams. Our analysis further shows that modality dropout becomes increasingly important as missing intervals grow.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了ROAM-ASD, 一个强大的ASD框架, 它联合模型音频,全面,和精细的口语信息。 ROAM-ASD使用统一的联合自觉,并带有模式不可知查询符,将所有可用的输入都装入没有预先定义的双向聚变路径,而模式退出则使模型暴露在培训过程中输入不完整. 对5个ASD基准的实验表明,在域内和零射线跨数据集评价方面,与以往方法相比,持续改进,在具有挑战性的WASD和UniTalk基准方面特别显著。 ROAM-ASD在分散缺失的观测中也非常强大,并且在单个输入流的长期损失下保持有用的性能. 我们的分析进一步表明,随着缺失间隔的扩大,模式的放弃越来越重要。
